text:
maria_partnerships: Quick heads-up — Graphcore reached out, offering a 4-week devkit preview for their new IPU v3 boards. They want an NDA signed + a short benchmark loop and weekly syncs to feed back perf issues. Who can lead on our side?

ravi_engineering: I can take point on the bench harness. Need to know telemetry constraints and what they consider "critical" data under the NDA.

jess_legal: I'll review the NDA. Ping me the version and any redlines you expect. Typical asks: no public numbers, limited internal access, 6-12 month publication embargo.

sam_perf: For benchmarks — recommend we measure steady-state throughput (tokens/s), p99 latency at 8k sequence, memory amplification, and KV-cache eviction behavior. Also want GEMM util and peak memory used.

lin_devtools: Are we sandboxing telemetry to a private S3 bucket? We should avoid shipping raw prompts externally.
maria_partnerships: Good call. Graphcore said they only need aggregated perf counters + anonymized logs. No prompt bodies. We'll propose a telemetry zip: {perf.csv, counters.json, anonymized-errors.log}.

ravi_engineering: Proposed plan — week0: NDA + ship devkit to Redwood lab; week1: smoke tests + minimal LLM run; week2: run 3 benchmark suites (chat, completion, embeddings); week3: perf tuning + quantization sweep; week4: joint review & exec readout.

maria_partnerships: That timeline works. Can we get one engineer on-site during delivery window? Graphcore prefers a remote pairing session but will accept onsite for setup.

sam_perf: I'll schedule the benchmark harness repo branch: `graphcore/eap-ipu3`. Basic run command:

```
# run the micro-bench
PYTHONPATH=./src python benchmarks/run.py \
  --model redwood-1-small \
  --sequence-len 8192 \
  --batch-size 1 \
  --repeat 250 \
  --output results/ipu3/
```

Make sure to enable KV cache logging and `--capture-gemm` flag.

lin_devtools: We should add an ingestion lambda to scrub user content before storing. I'll sketch the script and drop in the repo. Also add an RBAC group `graphcore-eap` in Okta.

jess_legal: I reviewed the NDA; two asks: (1) shorten the publication embargo to 9 months instead of 12, (2) clarify telemetry definition to exclude prompt text. I'll send redlines today.

maria_partnerships: Thanks. Action items: 1) @ravi create branch and add harness (due in 48h). 2) @jess send NDA redlines (24h). 3) @lin create scrubber + RBAC (72h). 4) @sam author bench run and perf dashboard template (72h).

deploy-bot: calendar invite created: Graphcore EAP kickoff — 2026-05-11 10:00 PT (link: https://cal.example/graphcore-eap).

ravi_engineering: Quick Q — do we have access to IPU profiling tools or will Graphcore provide them?

maria_partnerships: They can provide their profiler but require a signed tool-usage addendum. I'm looping in their partner rep in DM to get the addendum draft.

sam_perf: Also propose we include a small user-facing eval set (10 prompts) to sanity-check output quality after quantization. We'll keep it entirely internal and add ID tags only.

lin_devtools: Noted. I'll make the scrubber auto-remove any >50 char continuous segments that look like PII and replace with <REDACTED>.

jess_legal: Once I push redlines, we should get countersigned within 72h if Graphcore agrees.

maria_partnerships: Great — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for logistics. If anyone adds new attendees, please update participants. :thumbsup:
